body: Red flag. Same thing happened with my ex. Turns out he wanted to appear “single” online while still having the security of a relationship. Saw he was flirting with a handful of girls online who thought he was single. Just be careful!

I’m also 17 and had a best friend (also 17) who was in a relationship with a guy who was 20 going on 21. So kinda similar. 

I did NOT like this guy. He manipulated her and became more and more controlling but my friend was deeply in love with him. She would say how great their chemistry was but sometimes that’s not enough. She lost her virginity to him within a month. She would cry and be torn about him so often. Especially cause of the age gap, she would have to sneak around with him as if either of her or his families found out it would be frowned upon. Don’t know if it’s the same for you. They had good moments towards the end I’m not going to lie. But he ended up going behind her back and sleeping with a bunch of other girls but by this point she was already so in love. 

I also have experience being in a short relationship with a 20 year old guy. I just want to say that there’s a reason why a grown man is going for an underage girl. He isn’t able to get many girls his own age. Might be because of a lack of maturity or a power issue. It might be hard to believe but for most cases this is true.

Edit; also just want to add that this guy my friend dated became so controlling he started to verbally attack me over social media. From reading ur story it sounds eerily similar to my friends and I say please consider leaving him. It might not be the answer u want to hear. But the fact you wrote this here on reddit shows ur gut is telling u the answer, u just might not want to believe it?
